summary_en: CHUO SPRING authorized acquisition of up to 4.5 million shares (17.8% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for up to ¥15 billion through ToSTNeT-3 and market purchases from October 29, 2026 through October 28, 2027, as part of a six-year ¥150 billion+ capital allocation plan targeting ROE of 8%.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 28, 2026, CHUO SPRING's board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock pursuant to the Company Law Article 459 and the company's articles of incorporation. The company will acquire up to 4.5 million shares, representing 17.8% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum total of ¥15 billion. The acquisition period runs from October 29, 2026 through October 28, 2027, using ToSTNeT-3 (off-auction block transaction) and market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

The company stated that this acquisition supports its Medium-Term Management Plan 2030, announced July 30, 2025. As part of a broader six-year cash allocation strategy totaling ¥1 trillion, the company plans to deploy ¥150 billion plus additional amounts for treasury stock acquisition over the six-year period. The company prioritizes safety-focused investments, growth investments, and human capital investments, while expanding shareholder returns.

The acquisition is designed to improve capital efficiency and support achievement of an ROE target of 8%. The board considered future investment plans, stock price levels, market conditions, and financial forecasts when authorizing this program. The actual number and amount of shares acquired may differ from the authorized maximum depending on market conditions.
